site_seo_description: Vincenzo Prisco, software engineer and product builder. I design and develop web and mobile applications: explore my projects, experience, and contact details.
site_social_description: Vincenzo Prisco, software engineer and product builder. I design and develop web and mobile applications: explore my projects, experience, and contact details.
home_profile_education_body: I started programming in C# and building websites in high school. It was the quickest way I knew to try an idea and see if it worked.
home_profile_education_details: At university I studied computer science and software engineering. I wanted to understand what happens underneath the code I write.
home_profile_work_body: I co-founded a startup in a young team and worked on legacy code at large, established companies. I’ve also taken on independent client projects.
home_profile_work_details: I learned to adapt to different ways of working. At a startup you decide what to build first. With a product people already use, you start by understanding what needs to keep working.
home_profile_open_source_body: I believe everyone should have access to modern software, including people who can’t afford the most expensive tools.
home_profile_open_source_details: I enjoy contributing to open-source projects. I like knowing that a change we share can help someone work, learn, or build something of their own.
home_profile_fitness_body: I like taking care of myself in everyday ways. For me, that means making time for exercise and paying attention to what I eat.
home_profile_fitness_training: I’m currently following a training program with an athletic coach. I like having a plan and someone to talk to about how it’s going.
home_profile_gaming_body: I play on PC in my spare time. I like RPGs for the freedom to shape a character and find my own way through the story.
home_profile_gaming_details: In management games, I enjoy figuring out how resources, timing, and priorities fit together. “I’ll fix one more thing” can easily turn into another hour.
